why: Settings' Mute keeps focus after a mouse click, so a mouse player's arrows and Space go to the button instead of the tank. This survived under jsdom 30.1.2 while the case focused Mute on the hidden Settings pane: focus() refused the hidden button, and 'focus is not on Mute' held with no blur at all (measured while PR #1080 bumped jsdom). The case now opens Settings and checks focus landed first.
